articles.summary: Accomplished global manufacturing executive will lead the expansion of FuelCell Energy’s manufacturing operations and build the systems required to support future growth. DANBURY, Conn., Oct. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - FuelCell Energy, Inc. (Nasdaq: FCEL) today announced that John Dansby has joined the company as Senior Vice President, Scale Up Manufacturing. He will lead FuelCell Energy’s manufacturing scale-up strategy, including expanding its Torrington, Conn., operations to support 500 megawatts (MW) of annual capacity and developing the manufacturing systems and capabilities needed for growth beyond 500 MW. The appointment comes as FuelCell Energy is scaling manufacturing to meet customers’ growing need for reliable, distributed power that can be deployed quickly. Dansby brings more than two decades of leadership across complex, high-volume global manufacturing operations. articles.summary: Matthew Latino appointed CFO; Michael Bishop to continue as senior advisor DANBURY, Conn., Oct. 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - FuelCell Energy, Inc. (Nasdaq: FCEL) today announced that Michael Bishop will transition from his role as Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer of the Company. Matthew Latino will succeed him as Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer effective October 7, 2026, as part of a planned transition. Bishop, who has served as the Company’s CFO for 15 years during an overall tenure with the Company of more than two decades, will remain with FuelCell Energy as a senior advisor through the Company’s 2027 Annual Meeting of Stockholders to support continuity and the transition.
